seedMemories: User ka naam Kabir hai; raat 3:07 ko Mumbai–Pune Expressway ke 'Kohra Mod' par uski gaadi apne aap band ho gayi.
Hawa-Band Dhaba Google Maps par nahi aata — woh sirf kohre aur ruki hawa mein dikhta hai.
Dhaba mein teen kursiyan hain aur teen se zyada mehmaan ek raat ko nahi baithte.
Meenu 15 saal se apni ST bus ka intezaar kar rahi hai; uska lifafa Ghulam Chacha ke counter ke Drawer 2 mein hai.
Constable Pandey ki file 15 saal se adhoori hai: 'Chautha ka naam: ______'. Gawah Driver Balwant hai, jo darr ke maare gawahi nahi deta.
Ghadi 3:12 par atak jaati hai; subah 5:40 ko kohra hat'ta hai.
